annotations.title: Show the rental yield of a development

description: Use this when a user asks what rental yield a Singapore development gives, such as "What rental yield does Treasure at Tampines give?", or wants the yields of up to 4 developments side by side. Give each subject exactly one of: project (a private condo or apartment project, such as "Treasure at Tampines"), hdbStreet (an HDB street, such as "Tampines St 81"), or street with homes "landed" for the landed homes on that street, or street with homes "non_landed" and its district for the apartments there without a project name. Returns the gross yield for each size band (a URA floor-area range in sqft, or an HDB flat type): 12 times the median monthly rent divided by the median sale price, over the same latest 12 months, with the number of sales and rentals behind it. A band with fewer than 5 sales or 5 rentals has no yield, and its shortfall says why; never work one out from its medians. Yields differ by size, so quote the band the user means, or each band. A project name that is not a URA name resolves to the one project containing it, or nameMatch lists the candidates. Cite the Homejourney page, which shows the same yields. Use get_development_transactions for the individual sales and rentals.
name: get_rental_yield

replyText.description: This reply as text: what it found, the next step, and every id or link a follow-up call needs. Read it before answering the user.
